dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-to-medium grey skin tone consistent with a juvenile or sub-adult maturation phase.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse tonal variations across the dorsal surface with minimal localized clustering.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between subtly different pigmented regions; no sharp boundaries detected.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple high-contrast white punctate marks visible around the blowhole and scattered along the dorsal midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint transverse linear mark or skin crease visible immediately posterior to the blowhole.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, elevated longitudinal dorsal ridge is visible extending along the posterior half of the visible central axis.
